hyperparameter_search: none; one predeclared configuration per learner
interpretation: All models are compact stdlib implementations; the existing information-gain tree is not scikit-learn CART.
The comparison measures imitation of provisional researcher-defined rules, not clinical accuracy or independent validation.
Contrast and unsupported-condition rows are audited as outside the fitted task, not used as easy negative training examples.
Duplicate inputs within each partition receive one vote in primary metrics; repeated inputs across partitions remain disclosed.
Mapped-purpose groups contain one candidate; constant antiviral labels and tiny per-group support do not establish ranking or discrimination.
Model prediction cannot clear safety blocks, resolve an unknown fact, mark content/rules reviewed, or approve/publish prescriptions.
